fact: Libya Herald reports that Libya's state telecoms holding company LPTIC inaugurated the 8,700 km Medusa submarine cable in Misrata on 10 May 2025, a system the article says connects Libya with Mediterranean countries including Morocco, Tunisia and Egypt.

The article recalls that in November 2023 Libyan United International Company (LUIC) signed a contract to connect Libya to the Medusa submarine cable, a system it says links Libya with Morocco, Tunisia and Egypt among others.

A project official said the fibre link from Libya to the Chadian border should be completed by end 2026, with the connection with Chad already engaged with Chadian authorities and telecom firms (Le N'Djam Post).
